test_title: PYST 70: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

Did they invite you to the party?

options.text: Were you invited to the party by them?
Are you invited to the party by them?
Have you been invited to the party by them?
Had you been invited to the party by them?

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Were you invited to the party by them? .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **interrogative form** (question) in the active voice: *Did they invite you to the party?*
 
• To change this to the **passive voice**, the object of the active sentence (**you**) becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The structure for interrogative sentences in the passive voice is: **Was/Were + subject + past participle + by + object?**
 
• In this case, the subject becomes **you**, and the verb **invite** is changed to its past participle form: **invited**.
 
• The correct transformation is: **Were you invited to the party by them?**

Correct sentence: *Were you invited to the party by them?*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active Voice:** The subject performs the action. Example: *She wrote a book.*
 
• **Passive Voice:** The subject receives the action. Example: *The book was written by her.*
 
• To form a passive sentence:
 
 
• Identify the object of the active sentence and make it the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Use the correct form of the verb **to be** (is, are, was, were) followed by the past participle of the main verb.
 
• Add **"by"** + the original subject (optional, unless clarity is needed).
